test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Change for the better

options.text: Exchange an old product for new

solution:
The correct answer is **'An improvement in the situation.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'change for the better'** means** ****an improvement in a situation or state of affairs over what was.**
 
• For example, We can observe **a change for the better **in the admission process of the colleges.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Pretend to be someone else - Imposter.**
 
• **Exchange an old product for new - Trade-in (exchange an old article in part payment for another.)**
 
• **To keep loose change - The coins that you have in your pocket, keep them with you.**
